items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I knew George – Big George – from Brooklyn.

ctx.x: I remember that there was a guy I came to know, a guy named Big George. Tell me about – I just – I don’t know how I came to know this guy. Maybe it was in Slug’s. He was working with musicians.
Oh yeah. He was part of the scene. He was like a musician. I knew George – Big George – from Brooklyn. He would go around and help to drum up people to come out to places to listen to the music.
Yeah. He’s big too. He’s about 6'- . . .
